Description:
Explore the fascinating world of geology with this diverse rock and mineral collection, perfect for beginners, students, and enthusiasts alike. The set comes in two organized cases, showcasing a variety of rough, colorful mineral specimens, likely including quartz, jasper, pyrite, amethyst, and others, each housed in a separate compartment for easy identification and display. Additionally, this listing features a set of three replica arrowheads made from jasper, obsidian, and chert, presented on an informational card that highlights their historical importance. These replicas add an educational and historical dimension to the collection, making it a unique item for collectors or as a teaching aid. Both sets demonstrate authentic and natural mineral formation, and the arrowheads make a great conversation piece. Bid with confidence knowing that you are getting a genuine assortment perfect for hobbyists, classrooms, or display.
